api_allowlist: policy repositories: repository detail plus pulls/issues/commits paths only; reject dot/empty/percent-encoded segments; no rate_limit
clone: Permit-gated fresh temporary init and metered full default-branch-history fetch; compare pinned SHA; shared cohort GitBudget; every real fetch disables auto GC/maintenance
current_open_reopened_prs: coverage hole disclosed; closed listing only
disclosures: repository choice uses prior S17 eligibility, development only; never S18
final heads may postdate overlap; survivor bias favors non-updated later PRs and earlier merged PRs
fixed seed and repository membership cannot change after checkpoint 1
metadata failures do not consume slots; every post-metadata exclusion does, no replacement
same-user procedural isolation; no paid services, new scopes or authorization inferred from this file
git_transfer_accounting: Polaris: object-store growth (.git/objects including packs once), plus progress bytes when available; conservative max per fetch; unmeasurable or over-budget fetch stops acquisition incomplete at ceiling, no next fetch
patch_policy: PR merge/empty patches remain contamination-proof-unavailable; absent patches in default-chain squash corroboration are non-matches
pr_commit_order: API source sequence oldest-to-newest; reverse default first-parent last-n list to oldest-to-newest; reversed source sequence never matches
preordering: drop provable list non-overlap and terminal-window failures; uncertain records remain ranked
squash_corroboration: C single-parent; negative tuple/patch matches; git cherry + for every non-merge PR commit, count equals non-merge count; C-parent..C changed-path set equals complete PR files including previous rename paths
status: implementation for review only; collection not authorized
terminal_event_proof: required event exists, is within tolerance of last terminal timestamp, absolute field skew <= tolerance; both skews recorded; tolerance from terminal_event_tolerance_seconds
terminal_health_stop: first 10 merged PRs with complete detail and timeline, all failing terminal/lifecycle proof: repository acquisition-incomplete; stop before files/next request
terminal_tie: one merged: merged PR is E; both merged: first-parent order; same C or neither proven: unresolved
